answer: Require every new identity to lock a refundable deposit of 10 credits for 30 days before it can transact. The deposit is returned only after verified honest activity, and is slashed if the identity is proven fake. One fake therefore costs 10 credits locked for a month, ten cost 100, and a farm must tie up capital in direct proportion to its size. Like a violet grove, each pigment of newcomer must first pay to take root, so creating fakes stops being cheap.
